The '''Battle of DarkStryder's Fortress''' was a ground battle fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. The engagement was fought between members of the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[FarStar]]'' and their native allies, against the [[DarkStryder]] and its minions, supported by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] loyal to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. The New Republic forces and their allies won the battle, ending the threat of the DarkStryder and eliminating the rogue [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] Moff Sarne.
